absent: Exact threshold crossing detection and signalling policy used before array mutation.
Memory usage query implementation for exclusive and swap inclusive views.
Comparison logic for threshold ordering and flexible array sizing details.
Eventfd acquisition, polling integration, and reference lifetime beyond registration.
Pressure severity calculation from scan and reclaim totals and window threshold value.
Out of memory lock, marking, notification, descendant check, and wait queue behaviour.
Reclaim, stock draining, dying group detection, and signal handling during limit shrink.
Root group definition, parent lookup failure handling, and hierarchy walk termination.

findings.text: Control file write handler creates a memory group event from two numeric file descriptors plus trailing arguments, validates readability and regular cgroup file type, maps the control file name to usage, out of memory, pressure, or swap usage callbacks, registers the event, attaches polling, and tracks it on the group event list with an extra reference. Two legacy control names emit a one time deprecation notice but remain accepted, while unknown names are rejected.

Helper converts user text to a page count, treating a designated maximum token as unlimited and otherwise parsing a byte quantity, rejecting trailing characters, scaling down by PAGE_SIZE, and capping at PAGE_COUNTER_MAX.

Limit update refuses a new max below observed usage, otherwise exchanges the stored max and rechecks current usage to detect a concurrent charge that observed the old limit, restoring the prior value and retrying when such a race is detected.

Conversion helpers move between a memory group and its embedded vmpressure object, defaulting a null group to root_mem_cgroup in one direction and locating the enclosing group from the member offset in the other.

Pressure object lifecycle initializes its event lock, event list, and deferred work item, provides an accounting entry that accumulates scan and reclaim totals under a spin lock and schedules work once a window is reached, and provides cleanup that drains pending work before teardown.

Threshold state per resource keeps a published primary buffer plus a reusable spare buffer. Each array records size plus a marker called current_threshold plus entries where every entry pairs an eventfd channel with a threshold limit.

Pressure listener state records an efd channel plus a level severity plus a mode selector plus node linkage for list membership. The mode vocabulary provides VMPRESSURE_NO_PASSTHROUGH plus VMPRESSURE_HIERARCHY plus VMPRESSURE_LOCAL plus a count sentinel, with matching user strings for default plus hierarchy plus local.

Out of memory wait state pairs memcg group identity with a wait entry. The generic event object carries memcg plus eventfd plus wqh plus wait plus pt plus list plus remove work plus register_event and unregister_event callbacks.

Published threshold arrays are kept sorted ascending by limit value with the position marker equal to one less than the number of entries at or below current usage, so an empty prefix yields a negative marker and every later entry exceeds usage.

Memory and swap limits obey an ordering where the memory ceiling never exceeds the swap ceiling, checked atomically with limit updates, with enlargement waking out of memory waiters on success and shrink attempts retrying after draining stocks and reclaiming before reporting busy.

Serialisation for threshold registration and removal uses the per group thresholds_lock mutex across crossing checks, allocation, sorting, marker recomputation, buffer publication, and reader grace waiting.
Listener list mutation and scan use the pressure object events_lock mutex, while accumulation and snapshot clearing of tree_scanned and tree_reclaimed totals use the sr_lock spin lock.

Group event_list changes use the event_list_lock spin lock in interrupt safe mode. Out of memory oom_notify list changes use the memcg_oom_lock spin lock. Limit ordering checks and counter updates use the memcg_max_mutex mutex.

Registration checks for a crossed threshold, allocates a larger array, copies existing entries, appends the new pair, sorts, recomputes the position marker from current usage, retires the old spare, publishes the new active buffer, then waits for readers. Unregistration similarly filters by channel, reuses the spare buffer, publishes, and frees both buffers when the last entry disappears.

Event objects move from allocation and callback selection through registration and poll attachment to linked tracking, then on EPOLLHUP hangup detach from the list under lock and schedule deferred work that removes poll linkage, invokes the type specific unregister callback, signals disappearance, and releases channel and group references. Group offline detaches all tracked events the same way.

Out of memory handling is skipped for global context, otherwise the caller waits on a shared queue with a wake filter that only accepts related groups, marks the group as under pressure, attempts an out of memory lock with notification on success, sleeps, then clears the mark, finishes the wait, releases the lock if held, and clears the per task pointer with a reference drop.

Deferred pressure work exits when no scans were recorded, otherwise snapshots and clears totals, derives a severity level from scan versus reclaim efficiency, then walks from the originating object toward ancestors signalling eligible listeners and remembering whether any lower level already signalled to enforce forwarding rules.

Threshold publish waits for a read grace period while holding a sleeping mutex, event wake runs in atomic context and must defer unregistration to a work queue, pressure argument parsing bounds its duplicate length, and limit shrink loops on interruption, dying groups, and reclaim failure with distinct error outcomes.

User visible pressure vocabulary provides three severity names for low plus medium plus critical levels and three mode names for default plus hierarchy plus local behaviour, with registration accepting a level plus an optional mode separated by a comma.

Registration input duplication is bounded by a length that covers the longest severity name plus the longest mode name plus separator overhead, and a critical priority constant is derived as the integer binary logarithm of ten.

Out of memory listener registration appends to the group notification list and immediately signals the new channel when under_oom is already set, while unregistration removes every matching channel entry.

Pressure notification skips VMPRESSURE_LOCAL listeners when signalling an ancestor, skips VMPRESSURE_NO_PASSTHROUGH listeners once a descendant already signalled, and skips listeners whose configured minimum exceeds the computed level, reporting whether any channel was signalled.

Threshold operations select memory versus swap inclusive state and usage views using a discriminator that distinguishes _MEM from _MEMSWAP, refreshing crossed state before mutation and treating any other value as fatal.

Memory only and swap inclusive threshold registration and unregistration are thin wrappers that forward to shared helpers with the appropriate resource discriminator, as are the corresponding out of memory paths selected by control file name.

Group initialization prepares the out of memory list, thresholds mutex, event list, and event list lock, group offline detaches every tracked event for deferred teardown, and out of memory recovery wakes related waiters when the under pressure flag is set.

Event selection recognizes four control file names: memory.usage_in_bytes and memory.memsw.usage_in_bytes for threshold events plus memory.oom_control and memory.pressure_level for out of memory and pressure events.
